# Action Bar

An action bar groups related action buttons together, typically used for toolbar-style interfaces.

## When to Use

- Toolbar areas with multiple related actions
- Document or content editing interfaces
- Batch operations on selected items

## Jumpstart Implementation

| Jumpstart Component | Description |
|---------------------|-------------|
| `ActionBar` | Main container |
| `ActionBarButtonField` | Individual action button |

For code examples and API details, use the Jumpstart MCP tools:
- `get-jumpstart-components-apis` with `["ActionBar", "ActionBarButtonField"]`
- `get-jumpstart-components-examples` with `["ActionBar"]`
- `get-jumpstart-components-instructions` with `["ActionBar"]`
